text: Do not use a library gcd/lcm function: `std::gcd`, `std::lcm`, `__gcd`, `std::__gcd`, `boost::integer::gcd`, `boost::integer::lcm`.

Compute the gcd with Euclid's algorithm written by you (repeated remainder or repeated subtraction, iterative or recursive). Calling a library function, trial division, prime factorisation or any other method does not satisfy this constraint, whatever the function is called.
